summary: Frontend-only test of the kiosk hamburger admin popups (Betalingen, Huurders), Facturen popup regression, the bottom menubar change, and admin /admin regression. Tested on desktop 1600x900 and mobile 390x844 (on mobile the hamburger is hidden by design (hidden md:block), so the popups were opened by dispatching the kiosk-nav 'admin:<id>' event). No data was created, changed or deleted. Every delete/generate/confirm action was cancelled.

ui_bugs.issue: Two elements share the same data-testid kiosk-popup-{betalingen|huurders}-close: the X button in the header (from KioskModalShell testId+'-close') and the 'Sluiten' button in the footer (KioskAdminPopup). Both work, but the duplicate testid makes test automation ambiguous.

Deleting a tenant (from the row trash icon or tenant-detail-delete) uses the browser's native window.confirm('Huurder verwijderen?'). It does not show a confirm inside the popup the way Betalingen (payment-delete-modal) and Facturen do. This behaviour already existed in admin, but it does not meet the 'everything inside the popup' requirement.

The email dialog renders inside the popup host, but the strip just below the popup header is not dimmed (y~117-132 at 1600x900). Part of the 'Terug' button of the detail view still shows above the dim layer.

issues: The mobile payments list (mp-row) has no search field. payment-search only appears in the desktop layout. This matches admin mobile.
The 'Registreer betaling' button in the inline form wraps onto 2 lines at 390px width.

The hamburger admin menu is hidden below md (768px), so admin users cannot reach the Betalingen/Huurders/Facturen popups from the hamburger on a phone. This is by design in the existing code; confirm it is intended.

passed_checks: The kiosk desktop bottom menubar no longer shows Betalingen (kiosk-payments-viewer-btn-desktop count 0; no payments-viewer testid on mobile either)

Hamburger -> Betalingen opens kiosk-popup-betalingen-overlay with sm:backdrop-blur-md, month stepper (prev/next works: Sep 2026 shows 2 rows), search (filter 'Kevin' -> 1 row), 4 payment rows, footer Nieuwe betaling + Sluiten. No pending section (no pending data).
Nieuwe betaling: payment-modal is a descendant of kiosk-popup-betalingen-form, the 'Betalingen' header stays visible, and Annuleren returns to the list

Payment row -> detail inside popup with Terug, gekoppelde factuur, Wijzig (reassign panel opens), PDF, Verstuur (email dialog inside popup), Beveiligd, Verwijder (payment-delete-modal inside popup; Annuleren closes it)

Hamburger -> Huurders: search (Jan -> 1 row), filter bar, 5 rows with PIN/poster/delete icons. Nieuwe huurder opens tenant-modal inside the popup and Annuleren closes it. PIN modal opens inside the popup (both from the row and from the detail view). Poster opens a PDF in a new tab. Delete shows a native confirm, which was dismissed.
Tenant detail inside popup: Terug, gegevens, ID-kaart dropzone, NFC-tag, notes, Bewerk (tenant-modal inside popup, prefilled), Portal PIN, Handtekening, Verwijder
Mobile 390x844: Betalingen/Huurders popups are full-screen, and the forms open inline below the popup header

Facturen regression: popup opens, Genereer oktober shows confirm inside popup (cancelled), Jan Pieterse details show 3 invoice rows each with only a trash button, Nieuwe factuur shows inline form with 'HUIS 1A — Jan Pieterse' prefilled
Admin regression (boekhouder): /admin/payments and /admin/tenants show their headers; Nieuwe betaling/Nieuwe huurder open as full fixed z-[9999] overlays with blur
action_items: (Low) Give the footer 'Sluiten' button in KioskAdminPopup a unique testid (e.g. kiosk-popup-{id}-footer-close) so it does not collide with the header X
(Low) Replace window.confirm in Tenants.del with an in-popup confirm, like payment-delete-modal, for consistency with the 'everything inside the popup' requirement
(Low) Make the dim layer of the email/confirm dialogs cover the whole host area so the 'Terug' button no longer peeks through
(Optional) Unhandled 'Request failed with status code 403' pageerrors on the admin dashboard for the boekhouder role: add a catch for them
critical_code_review_comments: The ModalHostContext + translateZ(0) host makes the fixed-positioned payment-delete-modal (z-50, not portaled) stay inside the popup. This works, but it is fragile: a future fixed overlay with a z-index lower than the footer's would end up behind the footer.
KioskModalShell decides isMobile from window.innerWidth only at render time and does not re-evaluate it on resize (this was already the case).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; 3 low-priority cosmetic/consistency issues)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Kiosk admin login: get tokens with page.request.post (urllib gets a 403 from Cloudflare) from /api/auth/login (boekhouder) and /api/auth/personal-pin/login (kiosk.medewerker, pin 5566), set localStorage kiosk_token/kiosk_company/admin_token, then go to /kiosk. The hamburger is only visible at md+; on mobile use window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kiosk-nav',{detail:'admin:betalingen'})). The Facturen popup testid prefix is invoices-modal-*. Admin routes are /my-awesome-rentals-bv/admin/payments and /admin/tenants.
